title: Payment Performance Investigation
finding: Overall payment success rate decreased from 91.24% to 79.85% in the current window. The decline is concentrated in upi transactions routed through gateway-b (-25.32 pp for that slice). A deployment on payment-gateway-adapter (CHG-8841) preceded the change point by -15 minutes. Review required before any mitigation; the timing evidence does not by itself prove causation.
evidence: Overall success rate moved from 91.24% (baseline) to 79.85% in the current window (-11.39 pp), computed on 11,241 settled attempts (577 still pending).
Decline concentrated in: upi via gateway-b: 91.0% -> 65.68% (-25.32 pp, 5,026 attempts).

Change point detected at 2026-11-19 10:00 for upi via gateway-b: 90.22% -> 66.22% (z = -7.25). Deployment CHG-8841 on payment-gateway-adapter (gateway-b) preceded it by -15 minutes - timing evidence, not proven causation.
A/B readout (exp-2026-11-checkout-upi-v2): A 80.15% vs B 81.91% (+1.76 pp, p = 0.0015, SRM p = 1.0). Decision: hold: guardrail breach.

provenance.attribution: attempts attributed by started_at; settled attempts only

correlated_deployment.note: Gateway B adapter rollout v2.7.0 (connection-pool resize)

anomaly.interpretation: Timing evidence only: the metric change point follows the listed deployment; causality must be confirmed by engineers in gateway logs before any rerouting or rollback decision.

provenance.method: hour-over-hour volume-aware z-score, sustained for >=2 hours

decision_reasons: effect is significant but below the pre-registered minimum detectable effect; business value not established

provenance.statistics: two-proportion z-test, Wilson CI, chi-square SRM

recommended_actions: Verify CHG-8841 on payment-gateway-adapter: inspect gateway-b timeout logs around the change point and the deployment diff before and after.
Assess whether traffic can be safely rerouted away from the degraded gateway, then monitor success rate and latency for at least one full traffic cycle after mitigation.
Keep the current experience; address the breached guardrails and re-run the experiment before any rollout.
Re-run this investigation after the 577 pending attempts settle; late settlement can shift the exact rates.

governed_queries.sql:
SELECT
            COUNT(*)                                                              AS started,
            SUM(CASE WHEN method_selected_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)        AS method_selected,
            SUM(CASE WHEN initiated_at      IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)        AS initiated,
            SUM(CASE WHEN settled           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                    AS settled,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                  AS succeeded,
            SUM(CASE WHEN settled AND status <> 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS failed
        FROM payment_attempts
        WHERE started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end
              AND (:method IS NULL OR method = :method)

SELECT
            COUNT(*)                                                              AS started,
            SUM(CASE WHEN method_selected_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)        AS method_selected,
            SUM(CASE WHEN initiated_at      IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)        AS initiated,
            SUM(CASE WHEN settled           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                    AS settled,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                  AS succeeded,
            SUM(CASE WHEN settled AND status <> 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS failed
        FROM payment_attempts
        WHERE started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end
              AND (:method IS NULL OR method = :method)

SELECT method                                                               AS dim_value,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                        AS cur_settled,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS base_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS base_settled
        FROM (
            SELECT method,
                   started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end          AS in_current,
                   started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_start      AS in_baseline,
                   settled, status
            FROM payment_attempts
            WHERE started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_end
                  AND (:method IS NULL OR method = :method)
        ) t
        WHERE in_current OR in_baseline
        GROUP BY method

SELECT gateway                                                               AS dim_value,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                        AS cur_settled,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS base_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS base_settled
        FROM (
            SELECT gateway,
                   started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end          AS in_current,
                   started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_start      AS in_baseline,
                   settled, status
            FROM payment_attempts
            WHERE started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_end
                  AND (:method IS NULL OR method = :method)
        ) t
        WHERE in_current OR in_baseline
        GROUP BY gateway

SELECT bank                                                               AS dim_value,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                        AS cur_settled,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS base_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS base_settled
        FROM (
            SELECT bank,
                   started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end          AS in_current,
                   started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_start      AS in_baseline,
                   settled, status
            FROM payment_attempts
            WHERE started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_end
                  AND (:method IS NULL OR method = :method)
        ) t
        WHERE in_current OR in_baseline
        GROUP BY bank

SELECT app_version                                                               AS dim_value,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                        AS cur_settled,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS base_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS base_settled
        FROM (
            SELECT app_version,
                   started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end          AS in_current,
                   started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_start      AS in_baseline,
                   settled, status
            FROM payment_attempts
            WHERE started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_end
                  AND (:method IS NULL OR method = :method)
        ) t
        WHERE in_current OR in_baseline
        GROUP BY app_version

SELECT geo                                                               AS dim_value,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                        AS cur_settled,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS base_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS base_settled
        FROM (
            SELECT geo,
                   started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end          AS in_current,
                   started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_start      AS in_baseline,
                   settled, status
            FROM payment_attempts
            WHERE started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_end
                  AND (:method IS NULL OR method = :method)
        ) t
        WHERE in_current OR in_baseline
        GROUP BY geo

SELECT customer_tier                                                               AS dim_value,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_current AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                        AS cur_settled,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS base_succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN in_baseline AND settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                       AS base_settled
        FROM (
            SELECT customer_tier,
                   started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end          AS in_current,
                   started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_start      AS in_baseline,
                   settled, status
            FROM payment_attempts
            WHERE started_at >= :baseline_start AND started_at < :window_end
                  AND (:method IS NULL OR method = :method)
        ) t
        WHERE in_current OR in_baseline
        GROUP BY customer_tier

SELECT method, gateway,
               SUM(CASE WHEN settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                        AS settled,
               SUM(CASE WHEN settled THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)                        AS pending,
               COUNT(*)                                                        AS attempts
        FROM payment_attempts
        WHERE started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end
              AND (:method IS NULL OR method = :method)
              AND (:gateway IS NULL OR gateway = :gateway)
        GROUP BY method, gateway
        ORDER BY attempts DESC

SELECT method, gateway,
               SUM(CASE WHEN settled AND status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN settled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                        AS settled,
               SUM(CASE WHEN settled THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)                        AS pending,
               COUNT(*)                                                        AS attempts
        FROM payment_attempts
        WHERE started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end
              AND (:method IS NULL OR method = :method)
              AND (:gateway IS NULL OR gateway = :gateway)
        GROUP BY method, gateway
        ORDER BY attempts DESC

SELECT
            CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H', started_at) AS TEXT)                                          AS hour_bucket,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                  AS succeeded,
            COUNT(*)                                                             AS settled,
            SUM(CASE WHEN status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS success_rate
        FROM payment_attempts
        WHERE settled
          AND started_at >= :window_start AND started_at < :window_end
          AND method = :method
          AND (:gateway IS NULL OR gateway = :gateway)
        GROUP BY hour_bucket
        ORDER BY hour_bucket

SELECT change_id, service, gateway, deployed_at, note
        FROM deployments
        WHERE deployed_at >= :baseline_start AND deployed_at < :window_end
        ORDER BY deployed_at

SELECT DISTINCT experiment_id
        FROM experiment_assignments
        ORDER BY experiment_id
        LIMIT 5

SELECT variant, COUNT(*) AS assigned
        FROM experiment_assignments
        WHERE experiment_id = :experiment_id
        GROUP BY variant

SELECT a.variant,
               COUNT(*)                                                       AS attempts,
               SUM(CASE WHEN a.status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)           AS succeeded,
               SUM(CASE WHEN a.status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
                   / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)                                       AS success_rate
        FROM payment_attempts a
        WHERE a.experiment_id = :experiment_id
              AND a.settled
              AND (:window_start IS NULL OR a.started_at >= :window_start)
              AND (:window_end IS NULL OR a.started_at < :window_end)
        GROUP BY a.variant

SELECT
            a.variant,
            COUNT(*)                                                        AS attempts,
            SUM(CASE WHEN a.error_code='GATEWAY_TIMEOUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS timeout_rate,
            SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_duplicate_charge THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)          AS dup_charge_rate
        FROM payment_attempts a
        WHERE a.experiment_id = :experiment_id
              AND a.settled
              AND (:window_start IS NULL OR a.started_at >= :window_start)
              AND (:window_end IS NULL OR a.started_at < :window_end)
        GROUP BY a.variant

SELECT a.variant, COUNT(e.event_id) AS refunds
        FROM payment_events e
        JOIN payment_attempts a ON a.attempt_id = e.attempt_id
        WHERE e.event_type = 'refund_issued'
              AND a.experiment_id = :experiment_id
              AND (:window_start IS NULL OR a.started_at >= :window_start)
              AND (:window_end IS NULL OR a.started_at < :window_end)
        GROUP BY a.variant

SELECT a.variant, a.latency_ms
        FROM payment_attempts a
        WHERE a.experiment_id = :experiment_id
              AND a.latency_ms IS NOT NULL
              AND (:window_start IS NULL OR a.started_at >= :window_start)
              AND (:window_end IS NULL OR a.started_at < :window_end)
